units.source_text: 出发之日，与紫姬从容谈心，直至日暮，照例于夜深时分启程。

en.t: On the day of departure, he spoke calmly and intimately with Lady Murasaki until dusk, then, as usual, set out late at night.

units.source_text: 公子身穿布衣便服，旅装极度简陋。

en.t: The prince wore plain cloth everyday garments, and his traveling outfit was extremely simple.
He said to Lady Murasaki, "The moon has come out.

units.source_text: 你且走出来些，目送我出门吧。

en.t: Come out a little and see me off as I leave.

units.source_text: 今后离居，欲说之事定然堆积满胸。

en.t: Once we live apart from now on, the things I want to say will surely pile up in my heart.

units.source_text: 过去偶尔小别一二日，也觉胸怀异常郁结呢！”

en.t: Even in the past, when we were apart for only a day or two, my heart felt terribly oppressed!"

units.source_text: 便把帘子卷起，劝她到廊下来。

en.t: Then he rolled up the blinds and urged her to come out onto the veranda.

units.source_text: 紫姬正在伤心饮泣，只得强自镇静，膝行而前，在公子身旁坐下，月光之下，姿态异常优美。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was weeping in grief, but she forced herself to be composed, moved forward on her knees, and sat beside the prince; in the moonlight, her figure was extraordinarily graceful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“假令我身就此长辞这无常之世，此人将堕入何等苦楚之境涯！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "If I were to leave this fleeting world forever now, into what depths of suffering would she fall!"

units.source_text: 便觉依依难舍，不胜悲戚。

en.t: At that thought, he felt it unbearably hard to part from her and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 但念紫姬今已颓丧，若再说此话，势必使她更加伤心，便故意装出泰然自若的样子，吟道：

en.t: But thinking that Lady Murasaki was already dejected, and that saying such things again would surely grieve her even more, he deliberately assumed a calm and unconcerned manner and recited:
